items.a: ubik is an AI operations workspace for perishable food trade. It reads your email, WhatsApp, ERP and documents, flags supplier, shipment and order exceptions, and drafts the next action for your team to approve.
Importers, exporters and traders, typically teams moving 100+ containers or $25M+ in trade a year, where email and WhatsApp carry most of the operating work.

No. Your ERP and CRM stay the source of truth. ubik works around them, including Zoho, Dynamics 365 Business Central and ERPs with no API. The read and write touchpoints for your workflow are agreed during scoping, and nothing is written back without approval.

items.q: What can ubik do without an operator?
items.a: It reads, compares, monitors and drafts. Sending a message or writing to another system waits for a named person on your team to approve, and every change is recorded in an audit trail. The exact permissions, including when a workflow pauses or escalates, are agreed per workflow during scoping.

Your trade data is never sold, shared for advertising, or used to train third-party models. The website and product use cookieless PostHog analytics for usage events, with sensitive prompt and session fields protected before capture. The security note, subprocessor list and privacy notice set out what is processed and where.
Only what the chosen workflow needs: the approved inboxes, folders, files or systems. Your admin grants it through Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 and can revoke it at any time.

items.q: Which tools does ubik connect to?
items.a: Gmail, Outlook, WhatsApp, Dynamics 365 Business Central and Zoho, plus CRMs and other tools through connectors. The systems for your workflow are confirmed during scoping.

items.q: Do we need an ERP to use ubik?
items.a: No. Many teams start from email, WhatsApp and documents. ubik connects to an ERP where the workflow justifies it, including Zoho, Dynamics 365 Business Central and ERPs with no API.

items.q: How much integration work is involved?
items.a: It depends on the workflow. Most start with an approved inbox and the documents the workflow needs; ERP or CRM access is added only where it is required. Setup effort and prerequisites are confirmed during scoping, before the pilot starts.
Pricing is per workflow, with no user or token limit, and is agreed once the first workflow is scoped. Request a demo and we will walk through it with you.
Pick one workflow. We map it with your team, agree the scope and approvals, then run it as a controlled pilot. Success is defined before the pilot starts, and nothing expands until it is met.

items.q: What data is shared with LLMs?
a: Ubik minimizes what is sent to external LLMs. Models are used for planning, reasoning and drafting actions, not for bulk raw-data ingestion.
Sensitive context like RFQs, supplier pricing, margins, customer names and credentials is kept in Ubik's context layer. Customer data is never used to train third-party models.

One production workflow on the full Workspace: the mobile app for the floor, organisational memory, email and WhatsApp ingestion, connectors for your ERP, CRM and 100+ more apps, and an audit trail on every write.
Everyone on the team can use it. You pay for the workflow, not the people.

items.q: What happens after the first workflow?

Decisions run on your own context graph, so every approval, exception and precedent is kept and reused, with a policy engine, an audit trail, and a trade expert and a product engineer on the account.

items.q: How do credentials and private files work?

faq.a: Per workflow, with no user or token limit. The price is agreed once the first workflow is scoped, so it reflects the work, not your headcount.
Only what the workflow needs: the approved inboxes, folders, files or systems. Your admin grants it through Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 and can revoke it at any time.

faq.q: Is our data used to train models?
faq.a: No. Your trade data is never sold, shared for advertising or used to train third-party models.
